scientific_limitations_integrity.integrity: The quintic coefficient was derived from the displayed source vector field and checked by direct symbolic substitution. Prior cubic and global-stability results are credited and not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations_integrity.limitations: Local critical center-manifold asymptotics only; no claim of a uniform global convergence rate or of coverage of later transitions.

title: First logarithmic correction to critical relaxation in the five-dimensional Lorenz model
